text:
Sunita: Heads-up: I'm about to apply TF to add a new mixed GPU nodepool. Need a quick look for obvious pitfalls. Plan in comments.
Kevin: ping. Which instance families and how are you planning reservations vs spot?
Sunita: AWS. Trying p4d.24xlarge for high-memory models and g5.12xlarge as cheaper fallback. Wanted a small guaranteed on-demand baseline per AZ and spot for burst. Draft module:

```hcl
module "gpu_mixed_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/modules/gpu-nodepool.git//aws"
  cluster_id = var.cluster_id
  pools = [
    { name = "p4d-base" , types = ["p4d.24xlarge"], min = 1, max = 3, reserved_per_az = 1 },
    { name = "g5-burst" , types = ["g5.12xlarge"], min = 0, max = 4, spot = true }
  ]
  node_label = "workload-gpu=true"
  taints = ["nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule"]
}
```

infra-bot: terraform plan complete — will create 4 instances (total), 3 capacity reservations (1 per AZ), IAM role gpu-node-role attached.
Frank: A few items:
- Consider separate SGs for p4d vs g5 if GPU interconnect or nvlink tuning differs.
- CapacityReservation on AWS is per-AZ. If your module sets reserved_per_az=1 ensure you're selecting 3 AZs else you'll end up underprovisioned in an AZ.
- Scheduler packing: if you need contiguous GPUs (for model parallelism) you probably want a homogeneous pool per instance family and use nodeAffinity (node.kubernetes.io/instance-type) not just requests.

Alan: Also check driver and cuda install flow. The driver DaemonSet uses a node-role / instance-profile to fetch drivers from s3. Make sure the IAM policy grants s3:GetObject for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-gpu-drivers/* and kms:Decrypt if drivers are encrypted.
Sunita: Good call. Module currently attaches "gpu-node-role" with s3 read, but I will add kms decrypt. Also adding userdata to format and mount local NVMe for cache (/mnt/nvme). Will add ec2:AttachVolume permissions for lifecycle hooks.
Frank: Autoscaling: if using cluster-autoscaler set balance-similar-node-groups and --skip-nodes-with-local-storage depending on how you drain. If using Karpenter, set nodeTemplate labels + consolidation policies.
Kevin: Another gotcha: spot interruptions. Add lifecycle hooks and a preStop hook on pods to flush KV cache. Also test interruption handler DaemonSet.
Sunita: Will avoid in-place replace. Plan: create new pools, deploy driver DaemonSet and bootstrap, then cordon old nodes and migrate pods with graceful drain. Will run a small warmup job to load model shards to disk before shifting traffic.
infra-ops: Reminder: schedule the apply during maintenance window tonight 23:30 UTC. We'll watch CapacityReservation usage and quotas. Also check EC2 instance limits for p4d in the region.
Sunita: Thanks all — updating TF to split reserved_per_az param and pushing PR with plan output. @Alan @Frank @infra-ops please lgtm on PR when ready.
Alan: lgtm pending IAM policy tweak.
Frank: lgtm. Test interruption handler first.
Sunita: Will do. ETA apply tonight ~23:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
